shift_up.description: captured path moved up by 0.15 x scene depth

shift_down.description: captured path moved down by 0.15 x scene depth

spiral.description: captured path + circular offset of 0.08 x scene depth

dolly.description: mid-path camera moving +-0.35 x scene depth along the viewing axis

orbit.description: +-30 deg arc around the scene centre, looking at it

look_around.description: mid-path camera panning +-20 deg / tilting +-12 deg
